description: Turn price exploration on or off for your workspace, set its rate (at most 10% either way), or set how far past the prices already tried the optimizer may go (beyond_pct, 1 to 10%, default 5). It is on by default while learned pricing is on; turning it off gives every learned price exactly as computed. A field left out keeps its saved value. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope; from the dashboard, an owner or admin.

beyond_pct.description: How far past the lowest and highest prices a learned estimate was measured at the optimizer may price, in percent from 1 to 10 in steps of 0.5; null goes back to 5, the default. Refused until the pricing analyst is switched on for your workspace.

enabled.description: true turns price exploration on, false turns it off; null goes back to the default, which is on while learned pricing sets live prices (automatic or approve).

rate.description: The most a price may vary either way, as a fraction from 0.005 to 0.1: 0.03 is up to 3%. null goes back to 0.1, the default.

name: set_price_exploration
